module_microarchitecture.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact synchronous wrapper integrating host configuration, bounded request/response transport, freshness supervision, command limiting, telemetry, and deterministic safe fallback.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Use small registered control state to accept a host configuration only when enabled and the request boundary is ready, launch one bounded request descriptor, supervise response validity/sequence/age, and select fallback behavior whenever reset, disable, timeout, mismatch, invalid response, or fault conditions occur.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Maintain only small registers for enable/fault status, outstanding request sequence, response age, last accepted sequence, last valid response age, current mode, and previous bounded command. No deep buffering or payload storage is inferred.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive all externally visible outputs synchronously from registered logic: req_valid/req_* as outbound model-request transport, resp_ready as inbound response handshake, act_cmd/act_mode/act_valid as bounded actuator control, and sticky_fault/status/telemetry as compact status outputs.
ownership_notes: Owns the only legal top-level integration point.
Owns the external transport direction contract at the boundary.
Owns safe fallback selection, sticky fault visibility, and host-visible compact telemetry.
Does not implement surrogate inference, CFD, meshing, tensor math, or bulk payload processing.

module_microarchitecture.name: request_packer
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Small request-launch FSM with registered descriptor outputs.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Capture host configuration when host_cfg_valid is asserted, host_cfg_enable permits operation, and req_ready indicates the external boundary can accept a new request; then emit one bounded request descriptor and hold it stable until accepted.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Keep only a minimal launch/idle state plus registered copies of scalar request metadata and sequencing fields. No payload expansion or history buffering is used.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Assert req_valid and drive req_seq_num, req_geometry_handle, req_velocity, req_flow_summary, and req_mode as stable scalar metadata until handshake completion; assert host_cfg_ready only when a new configuration transaction can be accepted; pulse cfg_accepted on successful launch.
ownership_notes: Owns request packing and launch handshake.
Owns the compact outbound request descriptor fields only.
Does not widen, interpret, or store high-dimensional data.

module_microarchitecture.name: response_parser
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Bounded response-side handshake and scalar extraction staging.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Accept response transport from the external boundary under ready/valid handshake, stage only the scalar fields needed for control, and qualify parsed output only when the response is structurally acceptable and validated.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Use minimal registered staging for parsed scalar metadata and handshake state; no deep FIFO or bulk response buffer is inferred.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive resp_ready from synchronous logic and present parsed_valid, parsed_seq_num, parsed_drag_summary, parsed_lift_summary, parsed_age, and parsed_timeout as compact scalar outputs for downstream supervision and control.
ownership_notes: Owns response-side transport acceptance and scalar extraction staging.
Owns only compact response metadata, not model payloads or inference results.

module_microarchitecture.name: freshness_monitor
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Record the outstanding request sequence on launch, increment an age counter while waiting, and compare incoming response sequence and age against the configured timeout threshold to determine freshness and timeout status.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Maintain a small saturating age counter plus outstanding sequence register and a few status bits. No deep buffering or historical log is inferred.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive outstanding_seq_num, age_cycles, timed_out, response_match, and response_fresh synchronously; response_fresh is only asserted for a valid, validated, matched, and non-timed-out response.
ownership_notes: Owns request freshness supervision and stale-transaction detection.
Owns the timeout and sequence-match status used by safety logic.

module_microarchitecture.name: command_clamper
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Fixed-width, deterministic command generation with saturation and slew limiting.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Use validated drag/lift summaries as compact control inputs, compute a bounded actuator candidate, clamp it to min/max, then apply slew limiting against the previous command reference before allowing output validity.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Keep only the previous command register plus minimal combinational arithmetic support; no model payload, history, or complex math is inferred.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive cmd_value, cmd_valid, cmd_clamped, and cmd_slew_limited synchronously; never expose an unclamped or overslewed command as valid.
ownership_notes: Owns clamp and slew-limit indication bits.
Does not allow unverified response data to produce a valid command.

module_microarchitecture.name: safe_fallback_manager
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Deterministic conservative fallback selector with synchronous outputs.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Override normal command use whenever disabled, faulted, timed out, or otherwise unsafe, and provide a conservative fallback mode/command while enforcing host-clear behavior only when no active unsafe condition persists.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Maintain only the small state needed to indicate active fault and conservative fallback selection; keep behavior deterministic and synchronous.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive fallback_mode, fallback_cmd, and active_fault from registered logic, and provide the safe previous-command reference used by bounded slew behavior.
ownership_notes: Owns active-fault indication and safe command reference.
Does not clear faults while an active unsafe condition remains.

module_microarchitecture.name: telemetry_status
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Capture supervisory state for host visibility, including sticky fault, last accepted sequence, last valid response age, and current operating mode.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Store only small registered status fields; no logs, payloads, or history buffers are inferred.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive sticky_fault_out, last_accepted_seq_out, last_valid_resp_age_out, current_mode_out, and compact status synchronously from registered state.
ownership_notes: Does not influence control directly beyond reflecting registered supervisory state.

fsm_intent.name: request_packer
fsm_intent.description: A small idle/launch handshake FSM is implied to accept a host configuration transaction, emit one bounded request descriptor, and return to idle after acceptance.

fsm_intent.name: response_parser
fsm_intent.description: A small ready/accept stage is implied for response transport so parsed scalar fields remain stable during handshake.

fsm_intent.name: freshness_monitor
fsm_intent.description: A minimal supervisory FSM is implied for outstanding-request tracking, age counting, timeout detection, and response-match qualification.

fsm_intent.name: command_clamper
fsm_intent.description: Pure fixed-width registered arithmetic and output staging are sufficient; no explicit FSM is required beyond synchronous command update behavior.

fsm_intent.name: safe_fallback_manager
fsm_intent.description: Deterministic combinational-into-registered safety selection is sufficient; no complex FSM is implied.

fsm_intent.name: telemetry_status
fsm_intent.description: Registered telemetry capture does not require a complex FSM.

fsm_intent.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
fsm_intent.description: The top-level integration can be implemented as synchronous supervisory logic with small control registers and handshakes, without a complex monolithic FSM.

output_mapping: req_valid and req_* driven toward the external request boundary
resp_ready driven toward the external response boundary
act_cmd/act_mode/act_valid driven synchronously from bounded control and fallback selection

sequencing_notes: Clock and active-low reset fan out to all synchronous submodules.
Host configuration is accepted only when the controller is ready for a new transaction and enabled.
Request launch is single-shot per accepted configuration, with request fields held stable while req_valid is asserted.
The freshness monitor records each accepted request, tracks elapsed cycles, and rejects stale or mismatched responses.
Response data is only allowed into control once it is validated, sequence-matched, and not timed out.
Fallback behavior overrides command use whenever the design is disabled, faulted, or otherwise unsafe.
Sticky faults remain asserted until cleared under safe conditions, and clear_fault cannot erase an active fault source.
timing_notes: Use synchronous edge-triggered registers for all visible control and status outputs.
Prefer single-cycle or small bounded-latency ready/valid handshakes on host configuration, request, and response paths.
Keep arithmetic fixed-width and deterministic; avoid unsized operations.
Ensure act_cmd, act_mode, and act_valid are registered outputs with no combinational feed-through.
Maintain compact I/O and scalar metadata only; no high-dimensional payloads are exposed at the top level.
consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
